tools.name: list_chapters
tools.description: Table of contents of XCOPYBook, optionally filtered by group (front-matter, essays, editions, collectors, dao, conclusion, reference).

tools.name: get_chapter
tools.description: Text of one chapter by slug, with footnotes. Long chapters are paged by paragraph.

tools.name: search_book
tools.description: Find passages in the book and collector profiles that contain all the words in the query.

tools.name: list_collectors
tools.description: Collector profiles published on XCOPYBook, searchable by name or alias.

tools.name: get_collector_profile
tools.description: One collector profile by slug: identity, public links, biography with sources, and any statement the collector added.

tools.name: get_registry_info
tools.description: XCOPY registry scope, chain state and counts.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search XCOPY works by title or slug, optionally within a corpus. Empty query lists all.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: One XCOPY work by stable id or slug, with its tokens and sources.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: One token by chain (eip155:1 or eip155:360), contract address and token id, with its work.
